params.prompt: Isometric 3D diorama floating as a small rounded island on a plain solid deep charcoal #14110E background, with a soft warm contact shadow beneath it. Refined architectural scale-model craftsmanship: warm stone, cream plaster, pale oak, slate-grey roofs, muted sage greenery, tiny trees and tiny people going about their day. Golden-hour dusk light from the left, warm glowing windows, soft long shadows, tilt-shift miniature look, cinematic and calm. A single fine glowing red thread runs across the island to the building. Highly detailed, centered composition with headroom, absolutely no text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no signage. Subject: a modest modern hospital with a glass entrance canopy and a small garden courtyard; through a large window a calm reading room where two clinicians look at a softly glowing medical scan on a monitor; an ambulance bay and a few people walking in.
